source_text: Sed audiamus quid sermo divinus loquatur ad Moysen: Ecce ego assumpsi Levitas de medio filiorum Israel pro omni primogenito qui adaperit vulvam; redemptiones eorum erunt, et erunt mihi Levitae. Meum est enim omne primogenitum. Levi tertius nascitur ex Lia, et assumuntur in primogenitos qui natura non sunt. Apud Deum non illi primogeniti habentur qui corporea nativitate praecedunt, sed quos propositum cordis Deo patens primitivatus gratia suscepit. Quid est de medio? Sunamitis: in medio populi mei ego habito. Et Iohannes de Salvatore: medius vestrum stat quem vos nescitis. Christus stare in medio dicitur; imitator habitare in medio — nemo enim mundus a sorde. Levitae de medio: qui non cognoverunt dextram et sinistram sed legem Dei sequuntur. Melius est assumi quam primogenitum nasci. Sta medius fixus, non inclineris peccato, et assumeris de medio in primitivorum numerum. Haec pro eo quod scriptum est: et assumam Levitas de medio filiorum Israel.
pass_a_gloss: But let-us-hear what speech divine may-speak to Moses: Behold I took Levites from midst of-sons of-Israel for every firstborn who opens womb; redemptions of-them will-be, and they-will-be to-me Levites. Mine is for every firstborn. Levi third is-born from Leah, and they-are-taken into firstborns who by-nature not are. With God not those firstborns are-held who by-bodily birth precede, but whom purpose of-heart to-God open of-firstborn-status grace received. What is from midst? Shunammite: in midst of-people of-me I dwell. And John concerning Savior: middle of-you stands whom you not-know. Christ to-stand in middle is-said; imitator to-dwell in middle — no-one for clean from filth. Levites from midst: who not knew right and left but law of-God follow. Better is to-be-taken than firstborn to-be-born. Stand middle fixed, not lean to-sin, and you-will-be-taken from midst into of-firstborns number. These for that which written-is: and I-will-take Levites from midst of-sons of-Israel.
pass_b_english: But let us hear what the divine word says to Moses: [[Behold, I have taken the Levites from the midst of the children of Israel in place of every firstborn who opens the womb; they shall be mine — for every firstborn is mine >> Bible:Numbers 3:11-13]]. Levi is Leah’s third-born, yet those who are not firstborn by nature are taken into the firstborns’ place. With God the firstborns are not those who lead by bodily birth, but those whose open heart-purpose receives the grace of the firstborn portion. What is “from the midst”? The Shunammite answers, [[I dwell in the midst of my people >> Bible:2 Kings 4:13]]. And more magnificently John says of the Savior, [[There stands one in your midst whom you do not know >> Bible:John 1:26]]. Christ is said to stand in the middle; his imitator is said to dwell in the middle — for [[no one is clean from filth >> Bible:Job 14:4]]. Levites “from the midst” are those who have not known their own right and left, but follow the law of God. Better to be taken than merely to be born first. Stand fixed in the middle; do not lean into sin — and you will be taken from the midst into the number of the firstborns. So much for the word: [[I will take the Levites from the midst of the children of Israel >> Bible:Numbers 3:12]].
notes: Homilia II §§1–2 batch (not full Homilia CLOSEOUT; §§3+ ahead).
